description: Searches the ideas, criticisms and comments posted on Veritula, the most relevant first. Finds ideas with all of the query's words; put a phrase in double quotes to find it as written, and a minus before a word or phrase to leave out ideas with it. Without a query, lists the newest ideas. Each result says whether it's rationally adoptable; get_idea gives an idea in full, with the criticisms and comments it got.

adoptable.description: Only ideas that are rationally adoptable (true), or only those that aren’t (false)

author.description: Only ideas by this person, by their username

discussion.description: Only ideas in this discussion, by its id from other results

older_versions.description: Include versions that were revised since, which are left out otherwise

name: search_ideas
title: Search ideas
